Kay Kraft's Ekushey wardrobe
2016-02-16T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/kay-krafts-ekushey-wardrobe-511453

To pay respect to the martyrs, Kay Kraft has arranged this year's collection for International Mother Language Day. The motifs used in the collection are inspired from Bengali calligraphy, all done in colours black, red and white. Keeping the best interest of consumers in mind, Kay Kraft has tried their best to keep their prices low. The collection is on display at all its outlets. To see the collection, visit www.facebook.com/kaykraft. com.bd or www.kaykraft.com.
